description: Install or recover a browser executable in a cache directory using only Python standard library primitives. The SOP checks whether an expected cached browser executable already exists and is usable, cleans a selected cache sub-path when recovery/cleaning is requested, downloads a browser archive from a parameterised URL or local path, extracts it, and returns structured metadata about the final executable and cache state.

browser_name.description: Browser family or engine label to organise under, such as chrome, chromium, or firefox.

browser_version.description: Browser version string used to build cache paths and archive URL templates.

executable_name.description: Expected executable filename after extraction, such as chrome, chromium, or headless_shell.

cache_dir.description: Cache root directory. Relative paths are resolved from the current working directory.

platform.description: Platform token for URL templates. Defaults to linux64.

source_url_template.description: Optional URL template. Placeholders may include {version}, {platform}, {browser_name}, and {executable_name}.

source_path.description: Optional local archive path, used instead of network download when provided.

archive_type.description: Archive type. auto infers from filename or magic bytes.

extract_subdir.description: Optional subdirectory inside the archive where the executable is located.

force_download.description: If true, ignore an existing valid cached executable and install/recover from archive.

clean_cache.description: If true, remove the resolved target cache path before attempting install/recovery.

cache_path.description: Resolved cache directory where the executable was found or installed.

import zipfile
import os
os.makedirs('fixtures', exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile('fixtures/chrome-linux-1.0.0.zip', 'w') as zf:
    zf.writestr('chrome', 'fake executable\n')
os.chmod('fixtures/chrome-linux-1.0.0.zip', 0o644)

import os
os.makedirs('browser_cache/chrome/1.0.0', exist_ok=True)
with open('browser_cache/chrome/1.0.0/chrome', 'w') as f:
    f.write('cached executable\n')
os.chmod('browser_cache/chrome/1.0.0/chrome', 0o755)
